evals.name: register-author
evals.prompt: Write the method that records a registration for a given author.
evals.expected_output: A typed event appended for that author ID.
assertions: Appends AuthorRegistered(name.Value) for the supplied AuthorId; the stored event carries a string.
Returns the append result to the caller.

evals.name: read-registration
evals.prompt: Read the registration just written even when the author has other events.
evals.expected_output: A read filtered by event type, author and append position.
assertions: Checks result.IsSuccess before looking for the written event.
Uses GetForEventSourceIdAndEventTypes with the author's ID and registration event type.
Matches the returned position and checks the stored name.

evals.name: registration-time
evals.prompt: The listing needs the time the registration was recorded, not the time the listing was read. Show the read.
assertions: Does not append another event or read the wall clock.
